native_mechanism_note: Native xfade=transition=fadewhite ({duration_s}): luminance ramps up through white and resolves into clip_b. Softer/longer than light-flash-impact (0.2s overlay + SFX sting).
description: Exposure bloom: the outgoing shot brightens to white and the incoming shot emerges from it over 0.3-0.5s. Reads as revelation / despertar / cambio de estado. General-purpose energetic seam — a diferencia de light-flash-impact NO lleva sting y NO esta restringido al climax.

ffmpeg_params.sting_start_ms: = (dur_a - duration_s/2 - 0.192)*1000. Peak RMS del sting a 192ms (medido 2026-06-05); pico blanco del fadewhite = mitad de la transicion. Para D=0.4: dur_a*1000 - 392.

audio_recipe: Sting BUNDLED (parte de la transicion): swoosh-quick-stereo.mp3 (0.32s, InspectorJ Swoosh Quick Stereo Whoosh, user-uploaded 2026-06-05) a volume 0.35 (banda SFX HR#9), peak en el PICO BLANCO del fade. Base = acrossfade d={duration_s}. Para impacto fisico con flash usa light-flash-impact.
use_cases: Transicion a counterfactual ('si hubieras elegido...') — cambio de realidad
Despertar / recuperar consciencia / abrir los ojos (POV 1a persona)
Salto a momento de gloria en sport-choice (gol, celebracion)
Cambio de paleta narrative warm -> choice cool entre secciones
avoid_for: Climax peak con impacto fisico (usa light-flash-impact: 0.2s + sting, max 1-2x/reel)
Seams ordinarios entre beats — el blanco gasta su valor si aparece >2-3x/reel
Escenas oscuras donde el bloom rompe el grade eerie (revisa COLOR-GRADING.md)
Encadenar dos brightness-flash consecutivos (estrobo no intencional)
hyperframes_alternative: White overlay div z-index alto: gsap.timeline().to('.flash-white', {opacity:1, duration:0.18, ease:'power2.in'}).to('.flash-white', {opacity:0, duration:0.22, ease:'power2.out'}) con el scene swap en el peak.
canonical_observations: Authored 2026-06-05 por directiva del creator (timing 0.3-0.5s explicito). Pariente del light-flash-impact (validated_4/8) — la variante larga sin sting NO esta medida por separado contra referentes.
validated_notes: User-directed primitive. Validar contra >=3 referentes antes de promover de pending (HR#19).
